Neighbors Helping Neighbors

Making a Difference Through Service

From helping local families to supporting important causes, the Skowhegan Lions Club is committed to making our community and the world a better place.

Service Is at the Heart of What We Do

As Lions, we believe that even small acts of kindness can make a lasting difference. Our members work together to support local families, encourage young people, improve lives, and assist organizations that make a difference in our communities.

Our service includes scholarships, charitable donations, vision and hearing assistance, food assistance, and seasonal programs that bring hope to families.

Investing in Tomorrow

Education & Youth

Supporting young people and helping them build a brighter future.

🎓

Scholarships

We provide scholarship assistance to graduating high school seniors, helping students take their next steps toward higher education and future opportunities.

🌟

Boys State & Girls State

We support opportunities for young people to develop leadership skills, learn about government, and become engaged citizens through Boys State and Girls State.

🖼️

Peace Poster Contest

Through the Lions International Peace Poster Contest, young artists are encouraged to express their ideas about peace, friendship, and understanding.

Improving Lives

Health, Vision & Hearing

Helping people access the resources and assistance they need.

👓

Eyeglasses & Hearing Aids

We assist with eyeglasses and hearing aid donations, helping people in need gain access to better vision and hearing resources.

❤️

Health Awareness

We support health-related causes, including diabetes awareness, breast cancer awareness, and the work of organizations dedicated to improving lives.

🐕

Guide Dog Support

We support the work of Fidelco Guide Dog Foundation, which helps people who are blind or visually impaired gain greater independence through guide dogs.

Making an Impact

Supporting Important Causes

Our charitable giving reaches beyond our immediate community. We support organizations working to improve lives and provide assistance where it is needed.

American Red Cross

Supporting emergency assistance and disaster relief.

Susan G. Komen Foundation

Supporting the fight against breast cancer.

Maine Lions Sight & Hearing Foundation

Supporting vision and hearing services throughout Maine.

Fidelco Guide Dog Foundation

Supporting guide dog services and greater independence.

Blind Bowlers

Supporting opportunities and activities for people with visual impairments.

Right Here at Home

Helping Our Neighbors

Caring for our community means looking out for our neighbors, especially when they need a helping hand.

🍲

St. Anthony's Soup Kitchen

We provide food donations to St. Anthony's Soup Kitchen to help support its work feeding people in our community.

🛒

Thanksgiving Food Assistance

We make donations to local food cupboards to help families in need during the Thanksgiving season.

🎁

Christmas Gifts for Children

We help bring holiday happiness to local children by providing Christmas gifts to families who could use a little extra help.

🤝

Local Charitable Giving

We make donations to local charities and community organizations, helping them continue their important work.

Be Part of Something Good

Every project, donation, and act of service begins with people who care. We'd love to have you join us.
